gaps.sentence: A decision ___ once all the evidence has been reviewed.
gaps.explanation: The decision cannot make itself: future passive will be + made.

gaps.sentence: The manuscript ___ (BELIEVE) to be the composer’s last work.
gaps.explanation: 'People believe it is…' becomes 'it is believed to be…'.

gaps.sentence: This bridge ___ repaired twice this year already.
gaps.explanation: 'Already' + present perfect passive: has been repaired.

gaps.sentence: The company ___ (say) to be on the verge of bankruptcy.
gaps.explanation: It is said that... → The company is said to be... Present simple passive: is said.

gaps.sentence: Historic documents ___ (digitise) right now, which is why the archive is shut.
gaps.hint: action in progress now, plural subject
gaps.explanation: Present continuous passive: are being + digitised for an action happening around now.

gaps.sentence: Parcels ___ (leave) in the porch if nobody is home.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive: should be + left. A recommendation; 'are left' (routine) is also acceptable.

gaps.sentence: The escaped prisoner ___ (believe) to be hiding in the mountains.
gaps.explanation: Impersonal passive pattern: subject + is believed/said/reported + to-infinitive.
'By + future time' signals future perfect passive: will have been + processed.
